name: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
method: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add a pinch of salt and pepper and whisk with a fork until just combined.
Melt half the butter in a small non-stick pan over a low heat. Add the eggs and stir gently for 3 to 4 minutes until softly set.
Toast the bread and spread with the rest of the butter. Pile the scrambled eggs on top and serve straight away.
